comparison_scope: Descriptive task-aware structure-learning baseline outside the exact-budget 24-comparison Holm family.

source.wrapper_scope: Implement paper Section 4.1 around the released HERALD module: three HGNN propagation layers, with separate HERALD modules in layers two and three.

data.incidence_policy: Use the observed incidence matrix supplied to all methods. Do not append EHGNN-F's fixed self-loops because the published HERALD construction generates its normalized operator directly from the input incidence matrix.
data.split_policy: Use the same fixed 50/25/25 train/validation/test split for all six datasets.

model.layer_2: ReLU(Nhat_2 X_1 Theta_2), with Nhat_2 generated by HERALD from X_1
model.layer_3: Nhat_3 X_2 Theta_3, with Nhat_3 generated by HERALD from X_2
model.herald_hidden_justification: The released executable example uses width 4. Keeping this least-demanding released value gives HERALD its best opportunity to fit without changing the official module.
model.theta_schedule: a_l = 1 - 0.9 * (cos(pi*(l-1)/10)+1)/2 for l in {2,3}, matching paper Section 4.1 by passing theta=0.1 and num=l to the unchanged released module.
model.learned_structure: Each HERALD block constructs a dense weighted N-by-E incidence representation and a dense N-by-N residual propagation operator.
model.vendor_parameters: Retain all released parameters unchanged, including declared w1 and w2 parameters that the released forward does not reference.

training.stability_regularizer: sum over HERALD layers of the Frobenius norm ||N - N_res_l||

tuning.selection_rule: For each dataset, choose the complete configuration with highest validation accuracy. Ties prefer smaller HGNN hidden width, then lower dropout, then lexical config ID. OOM and failed configurations are ineligible and remain reported.

evaluation.statistics: Descriptive mean and sample standard deviation only; no inclusion in the exact-budget Holm family.

failure_policy.minimum_configuration_inheritance: The minimum-memory exact HERALD configuration OOMed on an otherwise idle 32 GiB V100. The remaining configurations use the same two dense HERALD blocks and equal or larger classifier state, so they are recorded as inherited OOM without repeated allocation attempts.
failure_policy.method_integrity: Record every OOM or failed cell. Do not substitute Fast-HERALD, sparse, projected, chunked, checkpointed, reduced-layer, or CPU-offloaded operators under the HERALD label.
